focus: San Francisco city limits: SoMa, the Mission, the Bayview / Bayshore corridor along US-101, Laurel Heights on Geary Blvd, and 19th Avenue near SF State
intro: These San Francisco listings were checked on operator-owned facility pages on November 27, 2026. They cover the eight Public Storage locations on the operator’s San Francisco city page and the four Extra Space Storage facilities inside city limits: SoMa (2nd St, 10th St, Folsom St, S Van Ness Ave, Otis St), the Mission (Treat Ave), the Bayview and Bayshore corridor along US-101 (Evans Ave, Marin St, Cesar Chavez St, Egbert Ave), Laurel Heights on Geary Blvd, and 19th Avenue near SF State. CubeSmart’s San Francisco page says it has no facility in the city. We copied published access hours and office hours separately. None of these facilities published around-the-clock access hours: the longest tables are 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM daily (six locations), the Geary Blvd page shows a “24/7 Access Available” badge beside a 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM table, and Extra Space’s Cesar Chavez St facility says 24/7 access is available by asking the site manager. Several SoMa and Mission locations close at 6:00 PM on weekdays and 5:00 PM on weekends, and the two Extra Space SoMa sites close at 4:00 PM on Sunday. Climate control is flagged only where the facility page lists it (three Public Storage locations), and month-to-month only where the page says so. This is a starting sample from two operators, not a citywide inventory; independents and the rest of the Bay Area (Daly City, South San Francisco, Oakland, the Peninsula) are not covered yet. We do not cache live unit prices or vacancy; fees shown are as listed on the date checked.

listings.area: Cesar Chavez St at Kansas St / Potrero Ave, near US-101, between Potrero Hill, the Mission, and Bernal Heights (94124)
listings.address: 2501 Cesar Chavez St, San Francisco, CA 94124

accessHours.notes: Published access hours are 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM daily. The facility’s 5x10 unit page says “24/7 access available — ask site manager for details”; the main page says extended access hours are standard.

officeHours.notes: Office hours from the facility page (Sunday listed as Closed). Phone shown is the facility number in the page’s company details; the page lists (415) 404-8605 as the current-customer line.

listings.visitNotes: The facility page says it offers “flexible month-to-month leasing.” It lists drive-up units and a drive-in building, enclosed vehicle storage, a covered loading bay, elevators, and aisles for trucks up to 12 ft tall. The page has a general paragraph about climate control but no unit we saw was labeled climate-controlled, so that flag is off.
listings.feeNotes: The facility page lists a one-time $29 admin charge and a $19.99 one-time lock charge (lock fee may be refundable with an approved lock; not charged for digital-access units), as listed on 2026-11-27.
